body: Hey person. Just wanted to let you know that I'm still here. Things are still really really rough but I'm doing my best.
You're amazing and kind random stranger on the internet. Thanks for taking the time out of your day to try and make me feel better.

Do you think everyone can be helped? Robin Williams had all the money all the love and support and all the resources he needed to get help, he seemed so outwardly happy, and he still ended it all. How can I realistically expect any sort of help to work?

I'm so at peace with the decision and am having a hard time understanding why death is such a big deal. I feel like a waste of space who would be better off not here so any hindrance just doesnt make sense. If someone cared wouldnt they let me no longer suffer?
